description:
Take a private tour with Boston CityWalks and make Boston yours, as we view its beauty, culture and history from its early beginnings to its striking 19th century architecture, as well as the special charm its unique neighborhoods still hold today. Boston CityWalks is honored to share our city with you on this specially created private tour.
 
Your guide will weave tales of the past with the interesting architecture and culture of Boston today.  We will take your input and interests and craft a tour especially for you and your group.  Starting and ending points will be arranged according to your interests and the specific tour requirements.
 
You can choose to do a historical tour, architecture tour or a cultural tour - or a combination of any or all.  Jewish? Irish? African-American?  We can put together a cultural tour for any - or a general cultural tour that talks to the various immigration patterns and ethnic groups in the city.

**Some possibilities include:**

- The Freedom Trail Historic Sites through Downtown and the North End
- Back Bay, Beacon Hill and the Downtown Freedom Trail to Faneuil Hall
- Excursion to Harvard Square and Harvard Yard
- Cultural Walk with orientation of your choice or in general
- The Waterfront and Seaport Areas
- ....... or leave it all up to us!!

If you have your own provided bus, we can arrange a combination step-on bus and walking tour based on what you wish to see.  That mix between sitting and walking is up to you, too!

To set up a private tour, please contact us directly by clicking "Contact BostonWalks" to the left of the page.   Shown above are Private Tours already booked.  To add yours, just contact us and we'll arrange the perfect tour for you.
What Is Not Included?
The details of your specially created private walking tour will be sent to you by email upon request.
This tour does not include snacks or drinks, although we will be happy to incorporate breaks or stops along the way.
Admissions, if any, to any historic sites or landmarks are not included.

___________________________________

**Meeting Location**
Locations TBD based on your request (Boston, MA)
(Exact meeting location details will be provided immediately upon purchase of tickets.)
